meaning.en: now, regarding those beyond even the fourth state who have cast off all bonds
meaning.hi: अब, तुरीयातीत अवधूतों के विषय में

meaning.en: what is this path
what is their state, their way of being
the grandfather, Brahma
to the divine father, the first Narayana
having approached, asked

meaning.en: to him Lord Narayana said
one established on the path of the avadhuta
exceedingly rare in the world, not something common
meaning.hi: संसार में अत्यंत दुर्लभ, सामान्य नहीं

meaning.en: if even one such person exists
he alone is eternally pure
he alone is renunciation given a human shape
meaning.hi: वही वैराग्य का साक्षात रूप है

meaning.en: he alone is the very form of knowledge
meaning.hi: वही ज्ञान का साक्षात रूप है

meaning.en: he alone is the Vedas in human form
so those who truly understand consider him

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the great soul
whose mind
rests constantly and only in me
meaning.hi: निरंतर और केवल मुझमें ही स्थित रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: and I remain established in that same state with him
meaning.hi: और मैं भी उसी अवस्था में स्थित रहता हूँ

meaning.en: the renunciant who still stays near a dwelling
the renunciant who wanders widely for alms
the swan-renunciant, and the highest swan-renunciant
staff, water-pot, waist-cord, loincloth, covering
offering into water
becoming one who wears the directions as clothing, i.e. unclothed
the three deep-rooted cravings (for family, wealth, reputation)
treating gain and loss as the same
sustaining the body the way a wandering cow grazes
wearing the appearance of one beyond the fourth state, wholly absorbed in non-duality
meaning.hi: तुरीयातीत अवधूत वेष में, अद्वैत निष्ठा में लीन

meaning.en: lays down the body while identified wholly with the sacred syllable Om
meaning.hi: प्रणव-रूप होकर देह त्याग करता है

meaning.en: he is the true avadhuta, he has accomplished all there is to accomplish
meaning.hi: वही अवधूत है, वही कृतकृत्य होता है
